defects: Restricts the linear map to an endomorphism f : V →ₗ[ℝ] V (domain = codomain), whereas the gold statement (and the informal statement's notion of 'norm-determinant') is for a general linear map f : U →ₗ[𝕜] V between possibly different spaces of possibly different dimensions
Restricts the scalar field to ℝ instead of the general RCLike 𝕜 in the gold statement, losing the ℂ case

Replaces the 'norm-determinant' (f.normDet) concept — which is the actual generalized notion being formalized and makes sense for non-square maps — with the ordinary determinant of a matrix representation (LinearMap.toMatrix b b f).det, which only exists when domain = codomain, so the statement fails to capture the intended generalized concept

Uses an unbundled Basis with a separate Orthonormal hypothesis indexed by Fin (finrank ℝ V) rather than the bundled OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 U used in gold, tying the formalization further to the finite square case rather than an arbitrary orthonormal basis
